title: 香港创新科技署：电动车量产不在香港，大湾区协同才是关键？
speaker: Kevin Choi

segments.en: What about manufacturing? Things like you mentioned green technology, EVs for example.
segments.zh: 制造业呢？比如你提到的绿色科技、电动汽车。

segments.en: What's the plan in Hong Kong? EV manufacturing, are there ongoing discussions, active discussions around that?
segments.zh: 香港有什么计划？电动汽车制造，有没有正在进行的讨论？

segments.en: I would have to say that of course, Hong Kong is still small in terms of land mass, especially when you talk about mass production.
segments.zh: 我得说，香港土地面积当然还是小，尤其是谈到大规模生产时。

segments.en: So when we talk about how exactly we are going to partner with the whole greater bay area, we should really focus on upstream, midstream,
segments.zh: 所以当我们谈论如何与整个大湾区合作时，我们应该真正关注上游、中游，

segments.en: of course, in some kind of pilot prototyping and some small scale mass production.
segments.zh: 当然，还有一些试点原型制作和小规模生产。

segments.en: That will be done in Loftain-Gong Park and also Centennial Bowl, because of the natural advantage that we have the academic strong background
segments.zh: 这将在白石角科技园和港深创新及科技园进行，因为我们有学术背景强的自然优势

segments.en: and also the government programs, science park programs to help incubation, acceleration and commercialization of our and the outcomes.
segments.zh: 还有政府项目、科学园项目，帮助孵化、加速和商业化我们的成果。

segments.en: These are the strong parts that Hong Kong should focus on.
segments.zh: 这些是香港应该重点关注的强项。

segments.en: But on the real mass production part and also in some way, some kind of also more affordable scientific scientists and engineers,
segments.zh: 但在真正的大规模生产方面，以及某种程度上，还有更实惠的科学家和工程师，

segments.en: they could come from mainland China too. They may be in greater bay area.
segments.zh: 他们也可以来自中国内地。他们可能在大湾区。

segments.en: In a way, you could tell that Shenzhen Hong Kong Guangzhou currently ranked first in terms of global innovation index in the world international property organizations ranking.
segments.zh: 可以说，深圳、香港、广州目前在全球创新指数世界知识产权组织排名中位列第一。

segments.en: It tells a lot that we are Hong Kong is not alone in doing this I&T.
segments.zh: 这充分说明，香港并非独自在推动创新科技。

segments.en: It must be a partnership within the whole greater bay area together with Shenzhen, Guangzhou and other GBA cities to make sure that the production chain is long enough,
segments.zh: 必须与深圳、广州及其他大湾区城市合作，确保产业链足够长，

segments.en: covered all the elements and green technology will be one of them.
segments.zh: 覆盖所有要素，绿色科技将是其中之一。
